title: What Northgate Care Protection Plans Do Not Cover
content:
Under every Northgate Care Protection Plans contract, damage that was present before coverage started, normal wear and tear, and filters, bulbs, remotes and other consumable parts are excluded. Commercial use of the covered product stays covered only where the plan says so for products bought on a business-segment membership.

## Exclusions by plan

| Plan | Damage present before coverage started | Normal wear and tear | Filters, bulbs, remotes and other consumables | Commercial use covered for products bought on a business-segment membership |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | No |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | No |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Yes |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | Excluded | Excluded | Excluded | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- The three exclusions in the first columns apply under all six plans alike.
- Commercial use is covered only for products bought on a business-segment membership; a product bought on a consumer membership is not covered in commercial use under any plan.
- Commercial use is a matter of the membership the product was bought on. Where the table says Yes, a product bought on a business-segment membership stays covered while used commercially. Where it says No — the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection and the Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan — commercial use is not covered, even for a product bought on a business-segment membership.
- A hypothetical example: a refrigerator bought on a Northgate Business Membership and used in a staff break room stays covered for commercial use under the Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan; a sofa bought on the same membership and placed in an office lobby is not covered for commercial use under the Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan.
